notes.title: Patch Notes for update 1.0.5
notes.content:
Many interface improvements:
[olist]
[*] Lobby screen rework to offer clearer support for many different controllers.
[*] Improved tutorial screen display to help onboarding new players.
[*] Optimized build size.
[*] Fixed some disconnection issues.
[/olist]

We hope you like the new changes!

Feel free to reach out with feedback and suggestions 🙂

notes.title: New Where is Billy?! Update
notes.content:
[list]
[*] The game is now available in Korean.
[/list][list]
[*] Mistakes have been fixed in Italian.
[/list][list]
[*] Unity version updated to 6000.0.26f1.
[/list][list]
[*] Several menus now adapt to more screen ratios (try the different possibilities with the lobby).
[/list][list]
[*] Added a section in the Credits (find out which one).
[/list][list]
[*] Red Light Green Light and Race: Reduced the Infiltrator’s run speed.
[/list][list]
[*] Scarefest: Hunters can win when a hunter catches the last Terror with their last bullet.
[/list][list]
[*] Other minor bug fixes have been done.
[/list]

We’re always fine-tuning the experience, have fun!

notes.title: Where is Billy? releases today!
notes.content:
🎃 It's almost here! 🎃  

Today is the big day! 🕵️‍♂️ Where is Billy? drops October 25, just in time for your Halloween parties! Whether you're hanging out with friends locally or hopping online, it's the perfect game to kick off the spooky season.  

With Halloween right around the corner and a fair price of just 6.99 USD, Where is Billy? is a great addition to your festive traditions. From its delightfully spooky art to hours of fun, it's the perfect excuse to gather your friends - what more could you want? 😉  

Available first on Steam, with more platforms coming soon !

You'll be able to play with us again live around 3 PM EDT here on steam !
